messages:
marta (design): quick note from the research lab: when users filter down to zero rules they say the page feels "empty" and they don't know what to do next. requests: clearer affordances + one-click actions.
kevin (pm): agree. reframe the empty state copy to be more action-first. idea: headline 'Nothing to route yet' then two actions: primary 'Create rule' and secondary 'Remove filters'. also show which filters are active inline.
leo (frontend): implementation bits: avoid swapping DOM height to prevent scrollbar jumps. i'll render a lightweight placeholder row and keep the container height stable. also avoid loading large illustrations — use a tiny icon + text.
yasmin (a11y): accessibility checklist:
 - announce: "0 rules. filters applied: service=auth, region=eu." via a polite status live region when the list updates.
 - the primary CTAs must have clear accessible names and visible focus ring.
 - if we surface an overlay in the preview area, it should use role=dialog with aria-modal=false and be dismissible via Escape.
marta (design): new copy proposal:
  "Nothing to route yet."
  "You have filters applied: service=auth. Clear them or create a rule to start routing traffic."
  primary CTA: "Create a rule" secondary link: "Clear filters"
kevin (pm): on preview: people thought the dimmed preview looked like a bug. prefer a small centered card that says 'Simulation paused' with reason lines like: 'No snapshot selected' or 'Sampling paused' and a single inline action 'Add snapshot'. keep the card visually lightweight.
leo (frontend): plan: overlay card with heading + one-line reason + primary action. if network is slow show spinner on the action. will keep it out of modal stacking (aria-modal=false) so keyboard users can still tab to the rules list.
yasmin (a11y): nit on reorder: testers couldn't find the handle in condensed rows. propose larger hit target and an accessible label: "Reorder rule: press space to lift, arrow keys to move". when position changes announce: "\"Block login spam\" moved to 2 of 6" in a polite live region, include rule name + new slot. debounce announcements for fast drags.
marta (design): visual hint for first-time users: a tiny tooltip the first time the editor loads: "Tip: drag rules to change priority or press space to reorder with keyboard." should be dismissible and not repeated per session.
kevin (pm): decision summary:
 - update empty-state text + surface active filters (owner: marta)
 - reserve min-height for list to avoid layout jumps (owner: leo)
 - preview should show a lightweight overlay card when inactive rather than a full dim (owner: marta+leo)
 - increase reorder hit target + SR instructions + polite announcements with rule name (owner: yasmin+leo)
 - show ephemeral first-time tooltip for reorder hint (owner: marta)
leo (frontend): i'll open a small PR with storybook stories: empty-state, preview-overlay, and reorder-a11y. will include data-test attributes and a test for keyboard reorder. ETA: 48 hours.
deploy-bot: deploying branch feature/routing-emptyflow to staging at 2025-11-03T04:00Z :rocket:
yasmin (a11y): i'll review the PR and run quick checks with NVDA and VoiceOver. pay attention to live region phrasing and focus management.
marta (design): thanks all 10 i'll add the mockups and localized copy tokens to the design doc.
kevin (pm): adding tasks to the sprint and will follow up in grooming. thanks team :)
